_comment: The one place the App Store listing is configured. Nothing else in the site
hard-codes an App Store URL or ID. After editing this file, run:
which rewrites the marked call-to-action blocks in site/*.html and the marked
block in site/_redirects, then rebuild the ZIP with scripts/make_zip.sh.
Set appStoreId to the numeric Apple ID from App Store Connect (digits only,
no leading 'id'), and appStoreUrl to the full listing URL. Leave both null
while Elemora is pre-release: the site then shows a 'Coming to the App Store'
state with a working mailto, and no dead links.
